Audited all 63 call sites of the 5 runBlocking gRPC clients (Vehicle/Trips/RecordingSettings/SurveillanceSettings/LiveStream): every call is wrapped in a Thread/Executor (or, for LiveStreamClient, entered on main then internally spawns its decoder thread) — NONE run on the main thread. Android also enforces NetworkOnMainThreadException by default, so a regression cannot fail silently. Added a debug-only StrictMode.ThreadPolicy().detectNetwork().penaltyLog() guard in BladeWatchApplication.onCreate (BuildConfig.DEBUG) as a forward regression detector. compileDebugKotlin BUILD SUCCESSFUL. No main-thread bug existed; no RPC semantics changed.

Made SurveillanceServiceImpl.CONFIG_BOOLEAN_TOGGLES descriptor-derived (enumerates every BOOL field of SurveillanceConfig via getDescriptor()/getJsonName()) so new bool fields are auto-covered and the list cannot drift. No additional omitted-scalar bugs. Added SurveillanceConfigTogglesTest (3 tests, green). Full connect suite green (Parity 23/23 unbroken). compile OK.
